findings.detail: X02 is firing on private credit fund limited partnership interests whose source schedule has no coupon fields to extract.

rationale: The flagged condition is missing interest_rate/basis_spread, but the raw Statement of Investments classifies the localized rows under Non-Controlled, Non-Affiliated Private Credit Funds / Limited Partnership Interests and prints N/A in the reference-rate, cash-interest/PIK, and maturity columns. The blank stored rate fields therefore reflect the source for non-coupon fund interests; the X02 check is over-scoped rather than identifying an extraction defect.
